vision: Consciously diffuse earlier biological states into the present.
evidence_boundary: No demonstrated method for shifting a body backward through experiential time is supplied. A past measurement is a reference, not a recoverable biological template.
prototype: Compare repeated, normalized measurements to a declared historical baseline; retain dates, units, missingness, and provenance. Use synthetic system-health measurements first.
hypothesis: An explicitly historical baseline makes deviations easier to audit than an unlabelled current-score dashboard.
metrics: Measurement completeness, reference-selection errors, and blinded reviewer agreement; never infer years of rejuvenation.
next_steps: Add measurement schemas and normalization; compare historical and rolling baselines on synthetic drift; recruit a measurement-science reviewer.
risks: Unit mismatch, cherry-picked baselines, regression to the mean, and confusing clock changes with functional recovery.
partner_route: Research data tooling grant or paid quality-assurance pilot; collaborate with an aging-data laboratory only after it defines a suitable nonclinical evaluation.

vision: A single conscious identity exists simultaneously across biological and synthetic bodies.
evidence_boundary: Replica consistency is an engineering property; it does not establish shared consciousness or personal survival.
prototype: Simulate three independent software nodes, quorum reads, node loss, and divergent states; start without physical robots.
hypothesis: Explicit quorum handling prevents a surviving minority from silently overwriting a newer agreed state.
baseline: Single local state file and last-response-wins replica reads.
metrics: Stale-read rate, unavailable reads, conflict rate, and recovery latency during repeatable injected failures.
next_steps: Add versioned events and network partitions; test leader loss and replay; later integrate one simulated robot with explicit operator control.
risks: Common-mode failures, lost updates, identity confusion, and unauthorized control of physical devices.
partner_route: Distributed-systems research collaborator or robotics lab; sponsor a failure-injection benchmark rather than mind uploading.

project: Bounded Energy and Repair Budget Explorer
vision: Tissue rewrites foundational laws and fuels indefinite regeneration from ambient disorder.
evidence_boundary: Adaptation can change regulation, not repeal conservation laws. Ambient energy needs a usable gradient, conversion mechanism, and measured losses.
prototype: Account for harvested energy, stored reserves, load, and deficits in a finite time interval. Use a virtual sensor node, not living tissue.
hypothesis: Explicit deficit accounting identifies configurations that cannot sustain an intended monitoring interval.
baseline: Model that omits reserve depletion or assumes a constant power source.
metrics: Energy balance in joules, operating hours before depletion, conversion losses, and forecast error on a later measured device.
next_steps: Add watts-to-joules integration and efficiency; compare with a known load; instrument a low-power nonmedical sensor only after a reviewed electrical design.
risks: Confusing heat with freely extractable work, incorrect units, and extrapolating device results to human metabolism.
partner_route: Energy-harvesting hardware company or university power-electronics collaborator; request measured traces and review first.

vision: Integrate infinitely many new sensory and cognitive dimensions without identity fatigue.
evidence_boundary: Finite systems have finite storage and compute. Task performance cannot prove consciousness expansion or prevent psychological fatigue.
prototype: Track named tasks before and after adding a new modality, with provenance and explicit regression reporting.
hypothesis: An immutable old-task evaluation detects performance regressions masked by higher average new-task performance.
metrics: Old-task accuracy change, new-task accuracy, calibration, memory cost, and evaluation-set leakage.
next_steps: Build versioned task fixtures; compare simple retrieval/replay baselines; only then evaluate a permitted pretrained model with documented model terms.
risks: Catastrophic forgetting, data leakage, privacy loss, unfair test composition, and inflated intelligence claims.
partner_route: Continual-learning group or accessibility technology collaborator; offer an open evaluation harness and modest defined engineering milestone.

vision: A biological network instantly reroutes instructions to reverse another organism’s decay.
evidence_boundary: Resource sharing can support repair services; it is not instant biological rejuvenation or proof of shared metabolism.
prototype: Schedule finite technician time, spare units, or laboratory capacity across requests, showing unmet need. The demonstration uses one interchangeable resource.
hypothesis: An explicit capacity-and-severity queue reduces hidden unmet demand compared with an unbounded task list.
baseline: First-come-first-served scheduling using the same total resource budget.
metrics: Unmet demand, wait time by severity, resource conservation, fairness across groups, and operator override frequency.
next_steps: Add deadlines and multiple resource types; simulate shortages; review priorities with affected communities before any real allocation.
risks: Severity gaming, discriminatory allocation, starvation of low-priority cases, and treating different resources as interchangeable.
partner_route: Community repair network or nonprofit service coordinator; start with a synthetic capacity-planning workshop.

vision: Store an informational blueprint outside spacetime and restore it instantly.
evidence_boundary: No accessible non-spatial storage field has been demonstrated. Ordinary copies require hardware, custody, energy, and restoration time.
prototype: Use multiple ordinary storage copies and independently trusted digests. Identify intact copies without overwriting damaged evidence.
hypothesis: Separated custody plus verified restoration catches failures that a successful backup job alone misses.
baseline: One backup location with no restore drill.
metrics: Restore success, corruption detection, key availability, elapsed restoration time, and site/common-mode failure exposure.
next_steps: Add a manifest and restic adapter; perform synthetic corruption and restore drills; develop access and key-custody procedures.
risks: A hash authenticates nothing without a trusted baseline; ransomware, shared credentials, key loss, and obsolete formats.
partner_route: Library/archive design partner or foundational software sponsor; ask for one archival restore scenario and independent review.

vision: Transform a living body between solid tissue, liquid arrays, and a coherent energy field.
evidence_boundary: Liquid/solid changes in engineered materials do not demonstrate a living body becoming an energy field or preserving identity through that change.
prototype: Compute an idealized latent-heat phase fraction at a transition temperature; expose energy, mass, and model assumptions.
hypothesis: A visible energy budget prevents a shape-changing materials concept from ignoring heat requirements.
baseline: Binary phase switch with no energy cost.
metrics: Energy conservation, transition-time prediction error after calibration, hysteresis, losses, and cycle durability.
next_steps: Add sensible heat, losses, and hysteresis; reproduce a published material dataset before proposing any bench apparatus.
risks: Idealized assumptions, burns, leakage, fatigue, and invalid extrapolation to implants or biological tissue.
partner_route: Soft-robotics or materials laboratory; seek literature reproduction and numerical-model review, not a consumer body-transformation device.

vision: Compress old memories into intuition without losing the self.
evidence_boundary: An archive or summary does not preserve a person’s consciousness, and compression can discard information.
prototype: Create derived category indices referencing unchanged source records; store a digest and retain originals. Start with synthetic notes.
hypothesis: Reversible indexing makes every derived category traceable to source records and preserves user correction.
baseline: Destructive summarization that discards original notes.
metrics: Source-link coverage, retrieval accuracy, correction success, accidental deletion rate, and cost of retaining originals.
next_steps: Add consent scopes and local encryption; evaluate retrieval on synthetic notes; add export and deletion workflows before personal-data pilots.
risks: Confabulation, privacy exposure, inaccurate categories, therapeutic overclaims, and insufficient deletion semantics.
partner_route: Personal knowledge-management maintainer or digital-archive partner; propose a privacy-preserving retrieval benchmark.

project: Error Correction and Damage Budget Lab
vision: Keep crucial biology in superposition so it bypasses thermodynamic decay.
evidence_boundary: Quantum coherence does not imply thermodynamic exemption, genetic repair, or human immortality. The included code uses classical bits only.
prototype: Demonstrate three-copy majority decoding under controlled bit flips and record redundancy and correction limits.
hypothesis: A visible failure envelope helps distinguish corrected single-bit errors from misleading claims of universal recovery.
baseline: One unencoded bit with identical injected fault scenarios.
metrics: Logical error rate, physical error rate, redundancy overhead, and failure under correlated faults.
next_steps: Enumerate single and multiple errors; add probabilistic independent/correlated-noise experiments; use a vetted quantum simulator only for a separately specified quantum experiment.
risks: Confusing quantum and classical correction, correlated failures, unmeasured correction costs, and biology extrapolation.
partner_route: Error-correction educator, reliability lab, or open-source simulator maintainer; fund a reproducible fault-model benchmark.

vision: Merge consciousness and biology with a sentient planetary biosphere to achieve immortality.
evidence_boundary: Ecological interdependence does not establish planetary sentience, consciousness merging, or individual immortality.
prototype: Track bounded transfers among named resource pools and compare restoration interventions in a transparent ecological model.
hypothesis: Explicit conservation and unmet needs make ecosystem proposals more auditable than an unconstrained benefit score.
baseline: Independent silo budgets with no shared resource accounting.
metrics: Resource conservation, shortage duration, calibration error, intervention cost, and habitat-specific outcomes chosen by field experts.
next_steps: Add external inputs/losses and multiple stocks; calibrate to permitted published data; recruit an ecologist and community steward before field collection.
risks: Oversimplified ecology, model misuse, sensitive-species location exposure, and decisions without local consent.
partner_route: Conservation research group or Conservation X Labs matching challenge; seek a bounded monitoring/recovery pilot with expert-led evaluation.
